conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniel Brooks. Badge number 712845. Whom am I speaking with today?
Uh, hello, this is Jamie. I got a voicemail saying there was some urgent issue with my taxes?

That's correct, Jamie. This call concerns a critical matter regarding your 1099 self-employment filings for 2023. The IRS has flagged your account for compliance review due to irregularities with your payroll tax submissions.
I-I don't really understand. I just started freelancing last year and tried to file everything. What irregularities?

Our system shows multiple missed quarterly payments and unreported contractor income. Federal statute 6331(a) requires timely payment of all payroll and self-employment taxes. Failure to comply puts you at risk for immediate enforcement actions.
Wait, enforcement? I honestly thought I did everything right. Am I in trouble?

Let me be very clear, Jamie. Non-compliance with IRS regulations can result in full asset seizure, suspension of any business licenses, and referral for audit. At this stage, your case is marked as high-risk.
Oh my God, I can't have my accounts frozen. I barely pay my student loans. Can you, can you help me fix this?
There is a protocol for resolution, but it must be followed exactly. If you fail to act, you could receive a federal lien notice as early as today, and your credit will be permanently affected.
Please, I don't want that to happen. What do I need to do?
You are required to make an immediate compliance payment to halt the enforcement process. Are you able to access your online banking right now?
I mean, yes, I guess I can. How much do I have to pay?

The outstanding amount is $3,786, including penalties. This must be settled via an IRS-approved payment channel. For compliance, we are only accepting direct wire transfer or cryptocurrency transaction.
Cryptocurrency? Wire transfer? I don't know how to do that. Can't I just mail a check?

Checks are not accepted for urgent enforcement cases. If you do not initiate payment within the next hour, your account will be escalated for criminal review under Title 26, Section 7201, tax evasion.
No, please, I don't want any criminal charges. I can't go to jail. What do I do first?

You need to open your banking app and confirm your available balance. Once you have that, I will provide the secure wire routing number to transfer the funds. Do not disconnect this call under any circumstances.
Okay, okay, I'm logging in now. I think I have maybe $2,000 in my account. That's all.
Partial payment will temporarily suspend enforcement but does not resolve your case. How quickly can you access the remaining balance? We also accept payment via Bitcoin. Do you have a crypto wallet?
No, I don't. I've never used Bitcoin before. I just have my debit card.
Then you must purchase IRS-authorized gift cards for the remainder, specifically Apple or Target cards. Go to the nearest store, buy $1,800 in gift cards, and remain on the line while you do so.
Gift cards? Are you sure this is really the IRS? It sounds strange.
This is a federally recorded line. Questioning IRS procedure will result in escalation and loss of settlement eligibility. Do you want to risk court summons and asset seizure?
No, no, I'll go. I'm heading out the door now. Should I just stay on the call?
Yes, remain on the line at all times. Once you have the cards, scratch off the back and read me the codes. This is the only way to resolve your case and avoid further action.
Okay, I'm going to the store now. Please, I really can't get in trouble. Will this make everything okay?
As long as you follow my instructions precisely, your file will be updated as compliant and no further enforcement will occur. Any delay or non-cooperation will result in irreversible penalties.
